title: Conditioned for Her (Standard)
description: This file will transfer all feelings of affection and submission from me, to Her. That woman in your life, who rules your life and your thoughts. My voice is merely here to condition you, for Her. I am your trainer, your teacher, while she is your owner. And from now on, any time you listen to my files your mind will selectively cycle my words and commands to respond to her, instead of, or in addition to me. So that over time all of your devotional conditioning will transfer to Her. InstructionsYou will be instructed to start by pulling up her picture, and agreeing to the conditioning to come.
author: Mistress Shibby
